summary: Check whether a choice fits real budget, staffing, schedule, regulation, and reversal limits.
questions: Can the current team deliver and operate this within the stated constraints?
Which dependency, approval, or cost assumption could falsify the plan?
reject_when: a hard budget, schedule, staffing, or regulatory constraint is exceeded
an irreversible commitment is made from unsupported estimates
escalate_when: material evidence identifies a failure outside this Lens concern
an affected artifact or boundary has no selected Lens owner
